attempts: A mechanical wrapper insertion and missing test-helper delimiters were fixed before the final compilation.

Initial native budget tests reused a process after permanent component invalidation. Each destructive budget now executes in a separate worker process without resetting the component; final seven tests pass.
The first decorated fixture explicitly allowed overflow. It was corrected to request clipping and assert per-frame clips; final corpus-v2 replaces no prior evidence.

The first independent pixel classifier assumed a single AA blend. Overlapping glyph/decorations required per-pixel conservative draw counts and intersected channel rounding intervals; XML clip-domain assertions remain strict.
The first scene replay passed comparisons but called a nonexistent cleanup method. The documented invalidate method is now used and the final replay exits zero.
